scope: Kansas fishing-guide credential and Milford Lake landings and fishing offers
recommended_first_source: The repeal of K.S.A. 32-964 and the current fee regulation K.A.R. 115-2-1. Kansas ended authority to issue commercial guide service permits on January 1, 2006. The fee statute still prints a cap. The readable fee regulation does not print a guide price and is not a roster.
highest_priority_permission_question: Will any Kansas office release a current list of businesses that guide sport fishing on Milford Lake, limited to business name and water, and authorize commercial-directory reuse? The commercial guide permit was repealed on January 1, 2006. The department website returned HTTP 403, so its terms were not read.

guide_license.historical_scope: Before repeal, commercial guide services covered big game or migratory waterfowl hunting or fishing for others on a commercial basis. The permit was a person permit.
